title: services.services.create
description: Payload of commands/service_create.sql. `hub_id`, `new_id`, `current_user_id` and `now` are injected by the runtime (§2.5) and are not part of the payload. A service is sold as one sale line with its VAT, so it cannot exist without knowing how it taxes: `tax_category_key` is REQUIRED here, at save time, and not discovered at the counter when the sale is rejected. Deliberately minimal — the closed domains (pricing_type), the ranges and additionalProperties belong to services#9, which hardens the whole CRUD.

name.description: Name of the service. NOT NULL in the column and with no fallback in the statement.

tax_category_key.description: Canonical fiscal category the service taxes by (ADR-0085), one of the `key` values of `taxes.categories.list`. `minLength` is not decoration: `required` alone accepts "", and "" is exactly no category.

category_id.description: Service category of THIS hub, or none. The statement checks the ownership and fails with `services.category_unavailable` if it belongs to another hub (services#7).

price.description: Minor units of the hub currency (ADR-0007/0123): 1500 = 15,00 € — never the typed-in major unit.
